name: Murrays coach student fare type
summary: Murrays express coaches (Canberra, Sydney, south coast, snowfields) list a Student passenger type for full-time students with ID.
who: Full-time students aged 16 and over with a valid Student ID card from a school, university or educational institution.
catches: Murrays' pages do not state how much the student fare saves.

evidence.quote: Includes full-time students aged 16 and over with a valid Student ID card
